selection_rule: The five confirmatory seeds are the next five consecutive integers after the highest BindingSlots model-training seed ever used in the program. replacement_policy.outcome_based_replacement: FORBIDDEN. A seed is never replaced because its result is inconvenient or below threshold.
replacement_policy.infrastructure_only_replacement: A seed may be replaced ONLY if it produced no valid training result due to a documented infrastructure failure. The replacement is the next unused integer (18, then 19, ...), chosen without inspecting model quality.
replacement_policy.restart_rule: A restarted run retains the same seed and configuration; resume is idempotent.
